name: roti (whole wheat flatbread)
notes: Good complex-carb base; pair with dal or vegetables for protein.

name: dal (lentil curry, 1 cup)
notes: High protein and fiber, low fat; diabetes-friendly.

name: white rice (1 cup cooked)
notes: High glycemic index; portion control matters for diabetics.

name: brown rice (1 cup cooked)
notes: More fiber than white rice, better for blood sugar control.

name: grilled chicken breast (100g)
notes: Lean protein, good for muscle-gain or weight-loss goals.

name: paneer (100g)
notes: Vegetarian protein source; watch portion size on heart-healthy diets.

name: banana (medium)
notes: Good potassium source; moderate sugar, count toward carb budget.

name: boiled egg (1 large)
notes: Complete protein; yolk has most fat and cholesterol.

name: spinach (1 cup cooked)
notes: Iron and vitamin K rich; excellent for almost any diet.

name: milk (1 cup, whole)
notes: Good calcium source; choose low-fat version for heart-healthy plans.

name: almonds (28g / small handful)
notes: Healthy fats; good snack for heart-healthy or diabetic diets in small portions.

name: oats (1 cup cooked)
notes: Soluble fiber helps lower cholesterol and stabilize blood sugar.

name: potato (1 medium, boiled)
notes: High glycemic index; limit portions for diabetes-friendly plans.

name: salmon (100g, grilled)
notes: Rich in omega-3s; strongly recommended for heart-healthy diets.
